32.21607,-95.85361: Site of Blackshear/Fisher School. Athens' first public school for African Americans was established in 1876-77. 32.29351,-95.54157: Rock Hill Cemetery. Rock Hill Cemetery has served this area since the late 1800s. It is located on land granted to pioneer Alexander J. 32.36894,-95.76929: Tidmore Cemetery. Pioneer L. H. Hobbs arrived in this area in about 1850 and was instrumental in the establishment of the community. 32.43817,-95.77252: Holly Springs Cemetery. In 1860, Robert K. Gibbs donated three acres of land near this site for the establishment of Holly Springs Methodist Episcopal Church, South. 32.44514,-95.70454: Ben Wheeler Community Just as Native Americans were attracted to this area because of the climate and resources. Early settlers also utilized these resources.
